As previously mentioned, the SQL SELECT statement retrieves records from tables in your SQL database. 

You can select multiple table columns at once.
Just list the column names, separated by [b]commas[/b]:[code format="sql" codeId="3033"]SELECT [b]FirstName, LastName, City 
[/b]FROM customers;[/code]

content.text:
如前所述，SQL **SELECT**语句从数据库表中检索记录。

你可以一次选择多个列进行查询。
多列之间用**逗号**`,`分隔:
content.text_html:
As previously mentioned, the SQL SELECT statement retrieves records from tables in your SQL database.

You can select multiple table columns at once. Just list the column names, separated by commas:

如前所述，SQL SELECT语句从你的SQL数据库中的表检索记录。

你可以一次选择多个表列。 只要列出列名，用逗号隔开。

content.content:
SELECT FirstName, LastName, City 
FROM customers;

content.name: 新鲜食品
content.description: 编写查询，获取食物的ProductName、ProductionDate和ExpirationDate的信息。
content.title: 查询多列

resolved.title: 食品新鲜度检查表
resolved.problem_statement_md:
在购买食物时，重要的是要确保食物新鲜，没有过期。
假设你一个食物表**products**，数据如下：

![](/content/assets/1a89a7450b283204af1a.jpeg)

请写一个查询，查询如下列(按顺序)：
- 食物名: `productname`列
- 生产日期: `productiondate`列 
- 过期日期: `expirationdate`列
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Selecting Multiple Columns[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

When buying food, it is important to make sure it is fresh and not expired.
You are given the following '[b]Products'[/b] list: [img id="4512" width="100%"]
Write a query to select the [b]ProductName[/b], [b]ProductionDate[/b] and [b]ExpirationDate[/b].
[note]Use the [b]SELECT [/b]statement and separate the required columns by commas.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用**SELECT**语句，用逗号`,`分隔所需的列。

code_templates.prepend_code:

  productname VARCHAR(128),

resolved.title: 查询所有列
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Selecting All Columns[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To retrieve all of the information contained in your table, place an [b]asterisk (*)[/b] sign after the SELECT command, rather than typing in each column names separately. 

The following SQL statement selects all of the columns in the [b]customers [/b]table:[code format="sql" codeId="3034"][b]SELECT *[/b] FROM customers; [/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2792" width="100%"]
[note]In SQL, the asterisk means [b]all[/b].[/note]

content.text:
要查询表中的所有列信息，请在**SELECT**命令后面加上**星号**`*`，而不是输入每一列的列名(当然也可以，但比较繁琐)。

下面的SQL语句查询客户**customers**表中的所有列信息：
content.text_html:
To retrieve all of the information contained in your table, place an asterisk (*) sign after the SELECT command, rather than typing in each column names separately.

The following SQL statement selects all of the columns in the **customers **table:

要检索表中包含的所有信息，请在SELECT命令后面加上星号（*）符号，而不是分别输入每一列的名称。

下面的SQL语句选择了客户表中的所有列。
